steps.label: Trivy
steps.sub: runs before the image is pushed anywhere

eyebrow: Both checks, later in the pipeline
code:
- name: Build container image
  run: docker build -t myapp:${{ github.sha }} .

- name: Scan the built image
  run: trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH myapp:${{ github.sha }}

- name: Deploy to staging
  run: ./scripts/deploy-staging.sh myapp:${{ github.sha }}

- name: DAST baseline scan against staging
  run: |
    docker run -t owasp/zap2docker-stable zap-baseline.py \
      -t https://staging.example-internal.com -r zap-report.html
caption: Image scan runs before deployment; DAST runs only after staging is live.
